title: Origin story: Heimdall
description: Heimdall was born of nine mothers, the daughters of Aegir, and raised to be the gods' eternal sentry. He guards Bifrost, the rainbow bridge, needing less sleep than a bird, and at Ragnarok he will blow the horn Gjallarhorn to summon gods and men to the last battle.

title: Ability profile: Heimdall
description: Ranked abilities: Vigilance — rank 100/100; Hearing — rank 100/100; Sight — rank 98/100; Horn-blowing — rank 95/100; Swordsmanship — rank 92/100.

title: Power ranking: Heimdall
description: Powers: Hearing so keen he hears grass grow; Sight reaching to the world's ends; Gjallarhorn, whose blast shakes the nine worlds.

title: Stamina feats: Heimdall
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Has stood watch since before memory, never sleeping; Will fight Loki to a mutual death at Ragnarok.

title: Crossover notes: Heimdall
description: Heimdall crosses naturally with: vigilance, hearing, the rainbow bridge.

title: Cultural impact: Heimdall
description: The eternal watchman; vigilance as a divine office.

title: Generator record: Heimdall
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Heimdall's database.
